title: AzureConfig
description: Configuration for the reference cloud-burst Provisioner backend (ARC-13 / ADR-20, #376): where on Azure to burst ephemeral compute nodes, how to size and price them, and how each node joins the cluster. Mirrored by zetta::AzureConfig in include/zetta/azure_provisioner.hpp and enforced by AzureConfig::from_json() in src/core/azure_provisioner.cpp — keep them in sync. No cloud SDK lives behind the provisioner; this config is interpreted by an AzureControlPlane (the reference AzCliControlPlane shells out to the `az` CLI). A malformed config is rejected at the boundary so a misconfigured burst fails fast instead of bringing up the wrong (or unbounded) fleet.

subscription_id.description: The Azure subscription the burst pool is created in.

resource_group.description: The resource group that owns the burst pool — the unit deleted on full teardown (stable name → idempotent create/delete).

location.description: The Azure region the nodes burst into (e.g. 'eastus', 'westeurope').

pool_name.description: Name of the burst pool (VMSS / Batch pool). Stable so create + delete are idempotent. Defaults to 'zetta-burst' when omitted.

vm_size.description: The Azure VM SKU each node uses (e.g. 'Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4'). Empty lets the control plane map the requested NodeCapability spec to a SKU.

image.description: The VM image reference burst nodes boot from (e.g. 'Ubuntu2204'). Empty uses the control plane's default image.

spot.description: Burst Spot / low-priority capacity (cheaper, evictable) rather than regular on-demand nodes.

max_price.description: Spot max price per node-hour (USD). Azure's convention: -1 pays up to the standard on-demand price (never evicted on price). Applies only when spot is true.

seed_peer.description: The cluster seed address (host:port) injected into each node's bootstrap so it auto-joins the existing peer cluster at boot. Empty when the join address is supplied another way.

managed_identity.description: Optional user-assigned managed identity resource id granted to burst nodes (the cloud-native side of the per-node burst identity).

tenant_id.description: Optional Azure AD tenant id, when the credential needs it explicitly.
